question: How many exact adapter bits per value preserve the task benefit of a problem-matched reasoning trace beyond the same marginal trace text paired with the wrong problem?

claim_boundary.in_scope: A causal result for MetaMathQA to GSM8K, all-linear rank-16 LoRA, and the three frozen base models named in the grid.
claim_boundary.out_of_scope: A universal law of reasoning cost, a claim about verbalized reasoning faithfulness, or a scalar predictor of rate across tasks.

same: optimizer, update count, LoRA shape, and base model
matched_contract.changed: The rationale body is assigned to a different source problem inside a length-sorted block of 32 rows.
matched_contract.prepared_data_gate: Donor IDs must form a bijection, stored hashes must match staged text, and aligned versus permuted scored-token totals at max length 1024 may differ by at most 1 percent for every model and seed.

estimand.paired_gap: delta(c) = GSM8K_accuracy_aligned(c) - GSM8K_accuracy_permuted(c), paired by model and seed at codec c.
estimand.conditional_trace_rate_90: The lowest measured exact file rate whose running maximum delta is at least 90 percent of the raw paired gap. A pair uses the larger of its two exact effective bits-per-value rates.

primary_tests.name: raw_alignment_gap
primary_tests.metric: mean delta(raw) over the 9 paired model-seed cells
primary_tests.success: mean at least 0.05, every model mean positive, and at least 7 of 9 pair gaps positive

primary_tests.name: binary_alignment_gap
primary_tests.metric: mean delta(binary) over the same 9 pairs
primary_tests.success: mean at least 0.05, every model mean positive, and at least 7 of 9 pair gaps positive

required_learning_gate: Each permuted raw adapter must improve its own held-out full-response NLL by at least 0.02 bits per token; a failed control fit cannot support the causal claim.
uncertainty: Report all 9 paired gaps, model means, the overall mean, and a 10000-draw hierarchical bootstrap that resamples models then seeds within model. Do not replace a failed primary test with another codec, threshold, or response measure.
prior_work_boundary: Reasoning Vectors already studies extraction and transfer of reasoning through model arithmetic.
MathShikkha already compares answer-only and chain-of-thought math tuning.
This test asks a different question by fixing the rationale multiset and measuring the exact update rate needed to retain only its problem-conditioned effect.
